parent_objective: Optimize lawful Magmaw 10N bots across every DPS, tank and healer against matched WCL.
latest_user_direction: Finish the Magmaw 10N implementation with subagents.
objective: Raise the three actors still below 0.95 on baseline b2-fd4ba456 (Blood DK 30002 at 0.80, Balance 30001 at 0.943, Elemental 30010 at 0.941) with one bundle measured as one 5-kill batch under the playbook keep rule.
hypothesis: Blood: on b2 k4 the tank's Dancing Rune Weapon copies hit at ~6% of its own hits because the Rune Weapon guardian never received its native scaling auras (51906 owner weapon damage + haste - 50%, 61697 hit, 110474 crit); applying them at summon restores the Blizzlike 50% copies (+1.0-1.3k). Glyph of Death Strike (59336) is a dummy aura with no handler; implementing +2%/5 RP up to 40% restores its native effect (+0.5-0.9k). Together with the setup-parity base f52d106673 (Blood glyph set +2.0k, Fallen Crusader +0.6-0.9k) the tank projects to ~25k against 24,844. Balance: 45.5-47.6k in clean stretches, 38.7k overall because parasite windows cost 4.7-7.1k: the policy switched to a threatening parasite without line of sight (8-11 failed casts per kill, 5 s spell blocks, walking toward it), mushroom sets fired on 1-2 parasites (4 GCDs for 24k), and Moonfire recast over a live Sunfire; gating the switch on the native LOS opportunity set (+0.8-1.4k), requiring 3 parasite hits within the native 6 yd radius (+0.6-0.9k) and forbidding Moonfire over Sunfire (+0.2-0.4k) project ~40.9k. Elemental: the b2 drop is proc RNG (non-proc DPS flat); the LOS gate removes its parasite LOS failures too; re-measure.
observations: b2-fd4ba456-k4, actor 30002: Heart Strike 22 casts avg 25.1k (25.7% of damage), Death Strike 11 casts avg 32.7k, Rune Strike 18, DRW copies 18 hits totalling 17.4k (0.8%); casts/min 37.9 vs WCL 36.2; runes/min 27.6 vs 27.5-29; Blood Boil worth <=0.4k (no parasite within 10 yd of the tank).
b2-fd4ba456-k4/k5, actor 30001: clean-stretch DPS 47.6k/45.5k; 8/11 line-of-sight failures at parasites; third mushroom set 2 hits/24k; Moonfire over Sunfire at 7.1 s and 57.2 s (k4).
Elemental DPS-066: hardcasts/min 35.1 vs 35.1, non-proc DPS 27.0k vs 26.7k; the gap is Dragonwrath/overload/Fulmination proc variance.
